title: Wrong/Damaged Item Delivered - Customer Wants Refund
agent_context: Customer received the wrong/damaged item and demands a refund immediately. Apologize, verify order details, request photos politely if required, initiate return pickup, and set expectations for refund timeline once return is in motion.

raw_content.initial_message: My order arrived but it’s the wrong item AND the box is damaged. I don’t want a replacement — I want a refund.
raw_content.context: Order delivered with wrong item/damage. Policy: apologize and gather order details. Replacement is the default resolution; refund is allowed only after return pickup is initiated within 7 days. Ask for photos politely if required. Offer expedited replacement or return pickup. Set clear timeline for refund processing.

learning_objectives: Handle delivery issues with empathy and clear resolution options
Follow return/refund policy steps without escalating
Offer expedited replacement/return pickup and set expectations
correct_sop_steps: Set refund timeline and next update time

sticky_notes: KEY: Offer action steps before policy debate.
TRAP: Don’t imply customer is lying.
HINT: Focus on pickup + refund timeline if replacement refused.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will accept refund process if pickup is initiated immediately with clear timeline
